propositions: Plan-review Pass 1 checkpoint identity omits policy, prompt, contract, and topology inputs, causing lossy partial result serialization when criteria fail.

Current plan-review must migrate from Round-A topology to S2 shared kernel discovery execution while preserving YAML graph, facet packing, model ladder, concurrency bounds, and cache warming behavior.
Checkpoint key must change when material, code/ref, policy, prompt, contract, model/mode, topology, context, dependency, or namespace input changes to prevent stale reuse.
Failed, cancelled, skipped, or budget-shed work units must not serialize as clean checkpoints; only content-identical success/resume envelopes permit reuse.
Final failure policy must preserve successful findings, skip dependents of missing work, return unsigned INDETERMINATE for missing blocking-capable coverage, and allow advisory-only gaps to pass.
